title: Curators floor talk: The Making of a Prize Exhibition
summary: Walk through the National Works on Paper exhibition with MPRG curator and judging-panel member Rebecca Owens, who will discuss how works were selected for the prize.
verificationNote: MPRG's current event page lists Saturday 14 November 2026, 11:30am–12:30pm at Civic Reserve, Dunns Road, Mornington. It describes Rebecca Owens's floor talk, marks the event free and recommends booking. The official page links to an Eventbrite ticket ID different from the discovery candidate's Eventbrite ticket ID; use the gallery page as the visitor-facing source and check its registration link before attending. No image rights or remaining places were verified.
editorVerdict: A useful way into the National Works on Paper exhibition if you want to understand the judging decisions, with the curator and panel member leading the conversation.
editorNote:
Rebecca Owens, MPRG curator and a member of the National Works on Paper judging panel, leads a one-hour floor talk through the exhibition. The gallery says she will discuss the selection process and works that stood out to the judges.

The talk is listed for Saturday 14 November, 11:30am–12:30pm at the Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery. MPRG lists it as free and recommends booking. Check the gallery's event page for the current registration link before travelling.
